traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Atherospermataceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite, monoecious, dioecious or polygamous; ovary superior, half inferior or inferior; floral cup present; stems woody; flowers solitary or in cymes; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals, tepals or absent; fruit achene; stamens (4-) 6 to 100; carpels 3 to 100. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 196, family Atherospermataceae: leaf margin serrate; read as "serrate".
